paper.title: Structured Scaling of AI Discovery Across Diverse Scientific Domains (SimpleTES)

lede: Where this run stands against what other methods reached on Erdős' minimum-overlap problem - the constant C₅ (lower is better). Published constructions come from the Together AI Einstein Arena repo, TTT-Discover, SimpleTES and Haugland; the newest records come from the community-curated list (teorth/optimizationproblems, constant 1b). For every method whose step function is public the bound is recomputed here from the sequence itself.
league_note: (Haugland, AlphaEvolve, TTT-Discover, Together AI, SimpleTES and the newer Einstein Arena entries from the curated list)
league_foot: Values are quoted as printed (lower is better). The SimpleTES paper presents its 0.380868 as the new record; the community-curated list has since added two lower, independently replayed entries (0.3808585749 and 0.3808585504). Change the Reference selector (top bar) to re-base every gap in this page.
footnote: All numbers are for the discretised problem: a step function h on [0, 2] with n equal steps, 0 ≤ h ≤ 1, Σh = n/2, score dx·max_s Σ_i h_i(1 − h_{i+s}) with dx = 2/n (overlap over all shifts, zero outside the support). Any such score is a valid upper bound for C₅; the best known lower bound is 0.379005 (White).
caution: Entries marked 'reported' (CodexProLong, Atris) are taken from the curated list as printed; the list states it independently replayed them, but their constructions are not downloaded here.

events: Erdős poses the minimum-overlap problem; the constant C₅ has been squeezed from above by explicit step functions ever since (0.5 → 0.4 → 0.3857 → 0.3820).
Together AI / Einstein Arena: sequential linear programming from the best known solutions, 600 steps → 0.380871.
SimpleTES (arXiv:2604.19341): 2400 steps → 0.380868, presented as the new record.
Einstein Arena paper (arXiv:2606.10402): arena best 0.380871 (prior best 0.380876).
Einstein Arena leaderboard: CodexProLong 0.3808585749 (3,584 heights, 15 Aug) - independently replayed on the curated 1b page.
Atris refines it to 0.3808585504 with 114,688 equal steps - also replayed. The curated page lists no newer verified result.
